description: Make Lukas's phone web app embeddable inside the native Zeroist app per docs/APP_PRD.md contract.

userStories.title: Embed mode hides the web app's own chrome
userStories.description: As the native app, I open /calendar?embed=1 and see only the page: no web tab bar, no top bar except the hamburger button and the screen title, content using full height. embed persists across in-app navigation (sessionStorage) and is also honored via cookie zeroist_embed=1.
acceptanceCriteria: A small helper in phone/src/lib (e.g. embed.ts) reads embed from the query, sessionStorage or the cookie, with unit tests
Shell hides TabBar and the TopBar chrome in embed mode; hamburger and title remain
Navigating between screens keeps embed mode
Screenshots phone/screenshots/W-001-calendar.png and W-001-analysis.png at 390x844 show no tab bar
userStories.notes: src/lib/embed.ts applyEmbed (head script + EmbedCapture) sets html[data-embed]; Tailwind embed: variant hides TopBar/TabBar in Shell, hamburger sits beside the title

userStories.title: Token handoff works on any route
userStories.description: As the native app, I open /calendar?token=T&embed=1 and the token becomes the auth cookie and is removed from the URL, exactly as it already works at /.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening /calendar?token=T and /analysis?token=T sets the cookie and strips token from the URL (verify TokenCapture/proxy.ts cover non-root routes; add a test)

userStories.title: Menu and pushed screens work embedded
userStories.description: As a tester on the Analysis tab, I open the hamburger and reach treatments, tests, biomarkers, devices, library, find my protocol, concierge, sources; each has a back button; Today and Protocol are not offered in the menu while embedded (they are native tabs).
acceptanceCriteria: Menu in embed mode lists everything except Today and Protocol
Each pushed screen renders in embed mode with a working back button

userStories.title: Notes for the native side
userStories.description: As the native loop, I read docs/APP_WEB_NOTES.md and know the exact URLs and query params to load, what embed hides, and how the token cookie behaves.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/APP_WEB_NOTES.md exists with URL forms, embed behaviour, token behaviour, and the list of screenshots
